questions.question: Explain the benefits of Surya Namaskar in weight reduction and fitness.
questions.solution_html:
• ((15 Marks))
  • Surya Namaskar (literally translated as "Sun Salutation") is a flowing sequence of 12 linked yoga
  • asanas performed to honor the sun as the source of all life. Practiced to synchronize the breath with
  • physical movement, it blends physical exercise with spiritual mindfulness
  • Benefits
  •  Burns calories and promotes weight loss
  •  Improves cardiovascular fitness
  •  Enhances flexibility
  •  Strengthens muscles
  •  Improves balance and posture
  •  Reduces stress and improves mental health
questions.final_answer:  Reduces stress and improves mental health
